newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Kellogg '97 EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Kellogg '97 EPS view cut.

text.p: -- SBC Warburg analyst Chris Jakubuk said he cut his 1997 earnings estimate for Kellogg Co to $3.30 a share from $3.50. His 1996 estimate remains $3.05.
-- The analyst also repeated his reduce rating.
-- Jakubik said he cut his 1997 estimate on the expectation of possible further price cuts by the U.S. makers of ready-to-eat cereals. Kellogg is the market leader.
-- He added that Kellogg's international cereal and convenience foods business were not able to compensate for the shortfall in domestic cereals.
-- Kellogg shares were unchanged at 64-1/2 at 1240 EST/1740 GMT Monday.
-- "It's difficult to go to an all-out sell when (Kellogg is) buying so much stock back," Jakubik said. He added that Kellogg stock repurchase programs provide support to the company's stock price.
-- He rates Kellogg a reduce due to a current valuation that, he believes, is at odds with earnings forecasts for the company and prospects for the cereal category as a whole.

-- On October 25, Kellogg reported third quarter operating earnings of $0.85 a share, before a $0.10 charge, down from $1.05 a year ago. Kellogg blamed competitive conditions in the domestic cereal market for its earnings shortfall.
